title: Intervention-driven Experiment Stop Rules & Signal Augmentation Playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: This ticket captures the playbook for intervention-led stopping rules for feature experiments (A/B tests, progressive rollouts, and dark launches) and the set of supplemental signals we will add to improve decision fidelity. The goal is to reduce both false negatives (not stopping a harmful change) and false positives (prematurely aborting healthy launches) by combining automatic signal thresholds with a lightweight human review workflow. This is targeted for latency/cost-sensitive features (inference runtime changes) and content-risk experiments where user-facing regression cost is high.
acceptance_criteria: A canonical set of automated stop rules (primary and secondary signals) is documented and published in Confluence

A dashboard with the top 6 signals (p50/p95 latency, token-cost delta, error-rate, hallucination proxy, feature failure rate, key-user cohort degradation) is created and linked in the experiment template
A lightweight human intervention workflow (Slack paging + quick review checklist) is defined and an oncall rotation owner is assigned
Signal thresholds and sample-size heuristics (minimum N, confidence interval bounds) are specified for three risk tiers: low/medium/high
One pilot experiment uses the playbook end-to-end and we record the decision timeline, alerts fired, and postmortem notes
planned_steps: Inventory existing signals and dashboards: runtime telemetry, console metrics, evaluator sample sets, QA synthetic probes
Define primary (auto-abort) vs supplemental (alert + human review) signals and mapped thresholds for risk tiers
Implement alerting rules in Grafana/Datadog for auto-abort eligible signals with documented cooldowns
Add a 'safety window' flag to experiment configuration so auto-abort only applies after minimum sample size and warmup
Create a human review checklist and Slack workflow template (message + attach quick metrics snapshot + approve/abort buttons)
Run a pilot with a low-risk feature (internal-only routing change) and iterate on thresholds and noise-reduction heuristics
Formalize playbook docs and add to experiment runbook templates in Confluence and the experiment setup flow in Console
